name: cli-session-boundary
body: The CLI session's boundary. Inside it: opening and closing the session, the extended worktree lock, the in-memory buffer and its live-index projection, the save flush, read routing through the session, and the socket crash marker. Outside it: the durable node files as the system of record, git history, the derived `db.lbug` index, and the transient plan/review `.trans` mirrors that stay session-free. Scan and merge sit at the boundary — they run once the caller saves and ends the session.
